name: parcels
description: Parcel tracking for one depot: the smallest PostgreSQL backend that shows a schema evolving in phases (expand, backfill, verify, contract) without a maintenance window.

modules.name: shipments
modules.description: Parcels registered at the depot with their declared weight.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: the label printed on the parcel

decisions.title: Schema changes ship in phases
decisions.rationale: Columns that existing rows cannot satisfy are added nullable, filled by a resumable backfill, verified on the target database and made NOT NULL only in an authorised contract phase; the evolution contracts next to this file show each step.

assumptions: the API key is shared by the depot's scanners
